title: Taiwanese American Student Association at Case Western Reserve University
content_html:
The Taiwanese American Student Association at Case Western Reserve University (CWRU TASA) is a student organization based in Cleveland, Ohio, focused on the Taiwanese American community on campus. The organization’s mission, as stated on its official university portal, is to empower and inspire the Taiwanese American community, to work with other cultural groups at Case to promote diversity, and to help develop personal friendships and professional networking through events and resources that explore Taiwanese American identity.

CWRU TASA hosts flagship events each academic year, including a fall Night Market — modeled after traditional Taiwanese night markets, featuring food and drink booths, games, prizes, and student performances — and a spring event called Plum Blossom. The organization is recognized by CWRU’s official newsroom and maintains an active Facebook page and Instagram presence under the handle @cwru_tasa.

CWRU TASA has engaged with the broader campus community through partnerships with other cultural student organizations and through speaker programming that addresses Taiwanese American identity and culture. The organization is affiliated with Case Western Reserve University’s student community platform and maintains a listed presence in the university’s club directory.
